description: Na₂MoO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ama2 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.57 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.62 Å. Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-50°. There are two shorter (1.79 Å) and two longer (1.81 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Mo trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Mo atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Mo tetrahedra.
